title: Police Blotter: 16 booked in Webb County — end-of-day roundup
excerpt: Sixteen people were booked into the Webb County Jail on November 13, 2026, on alleged misdemeanor charges and holds — DWI, assault, marijuana and controlled-substance possession, theft and more. Every arrest is an allegation; each person is presumed innocent until proven guilty.
content:
Sixteen people were booked into the Webb County Jail on Friday, November 13, 2026, on alleged misdemeanor charges and holds, according to Webb County booking records. Each person is listed below with the charge shown in their booking record. An arrest is an allegation, not a conviction, and every person named here is presumed innocent until proven guilty in a court of law.

Debra Lee Palacios was arrested on Friday, November 13, 2026, at 12:42 a.m. on an alleged charge of possession of a controlled substance, Penalty Group 3, less than 28 grams, a Class A misdemeanor. No bond had been set at the time of booking. She was arrested by the Laredo Police Department.
